en.t: The temple was wrapped in a deep, silent stillness.

units.source_text: 金阁里只有我独自一人。

en.t: Inside the Golden Pavilion, I was completely alone.

units.source_text: 我站在月光照射不到的地方时，就感到金阁沉重而奢华的黑暗包围着我，

en.t: When I stood where the moonlight could not reach, I felt the heavy, luxurious darkness of the Golden Pavilion surrounding me,

units.source_text: 我心旷神恰，渐渐深深地沉浸在这种现实的感觉中。

en.t: and my heart opened with ease as I gradually sank deep into this sense of reality.

units.source_text: 这种感觉又原封不动地变成了幻觉。

en.t: That feeling then turned, unchanged, into a hallucination.
